=== when something fails
$ … | bash

   ✓ Downloaded                   24.1 MB
   ✗ Verified              checksum does not match
     expected 3f9c1a…   got 77be02…
     The download may be corrupted or tampered with. Nothing was installed.

 Fix   run the command again, or pin a version with --version 0.9.2
 Help  https://orion.thesunday.studio/docs/install

$ echo $?
1

=== already installed
$ … | bash

   ✓ Already on 0.9.2             nothing to do
   ✓ Service                      running

   ▸ orion-node status

--- notes
NOTE Nothing blocks on setup: Install never asks a question. When it ends the host is already reporting CPU, memory, disk and network.
NOTE One line about detection: Detected 6 things to monitor with the two ways to review: orion-node setup or the Console link.
NOTE Doctor box and link: The result card carries the doctor summary and the server's Console link, so the next step is one copy away.
NOTE A script, so no Go here: Plain bash so it is easy to audit; spinners are a carriage-return redraw and each step prints one line without a TTY.
